BUILDPLAN.md T-04a (M1).

The phase machine: `idle→…→released`, host-only transitions, no skipping, `trace_step`; **the sealed `answers` module** unreachable from the public state query, proven by a type/module boundary test

Criteria: AC-45, AC-47, AC-61, AC-81, AC-93, AC-97, G-3, G-6
Harness hooks: see EVALUATION.md rows for those IDs; `just test` is the inner loop (≤ 60 s).
Depends on (BUILDPLAN): T-03
BUILDPLAN notes: Built alone and first; `room/src/phase.rs` is consumed by everything in M1

Orchestrator notes: `room/src/phase.rs` is consumed by everything in M1: build it alone and first. AC-61 is a type or module boundary proof, not a review.

Workflow mode: sub-agent-full. Terminal pre-merge status: review. PR base: origin/main.
Standing clauses: criteria outrank SPEC on behaviour, state, payloads and copy; SPEC outranks the prototype, which wins on visual detail only. Never write down what a program prints. Answer position is a uniform draw from the date, never balanced. Miri proves absence of UB on executed paths only. Colour is never the only signal. Code never causes horizontal page scroll. Never `git add -A`. Signing goes through 1Password: retry once, then escalate.

Plan: filled in by the delegator's plan phase.

READY PQ-4 CWD /Users/michellerojas/rust-nyc-pop-quiz-worktrees/phase-machine HEAD 696b3cea87af33ec0a75a4c01ede0d820e460863 BASE 696b3cea87af33ec0a75a4c01ede0d820e460863 MODE active

PQ-4 plan note for the Orchestrator (contract tension, side taken): boot-prompt §2 says the sealed module derives the correct index 'by option kind for does-not-compile, panic and ub', but pipeline/src/popquiz/bank.py correct_index matches by kind ONLY for does_not_compile and by text==normalized stdout for everything else (panic/ub included). The room's Rust twin mirrors bank.py exactly so the two cannot drift; a panic question whose option text is not stdout is refused at load by both. If you rule otherwise, both twins change together. Second: bank/schema says file order is not wall order; the room treats the pushed record's order as wall order and never arranges (arrangement is T-20's push).

DONE PQ-4 PR https://github.com/mrojas54/rust-nyc-pop-quiz/pull/15 HEAD f7faccdf20e79c783e3945e4598eba4cc29e4962 BASE 696b3cea87af33ec0a75a4c01ede0d820e460863 test-warm 2.6s (just test-room: 45 tests + 12 doctests) deviations: (1) correct index mirrors bank.correct_index exactly (by kind only for does_not_compile, by text for panic/ub too), not the ticket's 'by kind for panic and ub' — twins must not drift; needs your ruling, both twins change together. (2) Room treats the pushed record's option order as wall order and never arranges; bank schema says file order is not wall order, so T-20's push must arrange (q3 in tests is bank order, fine for tests, not for HC-0). (3) Hint only in the buzzer's live payload (§4.2/AC-48), not wall/host. (4) Run it again = authorize_create + same organizer + a question not yet released (in-memory set, only writer is release; T-11's ledger replaces it); refused for the same question. (5) Room stays in memory as released; deletion at release/expiry is T-11's. (6) ←/→ at a bound are refused (409), not ignored. (7) Refusal reasons are API diagnostics, not §11 copy; kept clear of the Forbidden patterns — flag for T-22. (8) Receipt canary planted via a synthetic does-not-compile record with code ECANARY0 (the receipt is derived, so it cannot be planted directly). notes: getrandom 0.3 + subtle 2.6 added (already in lock, offline, no network); serde/serde_json now non-optional and dropped from the spike feature; cargo check --features spike green. just test-pipeline cannot start on this machine (pyenv python3.12 missing libintl.8.dylib, known client env) — no pipeline file changed. G-6: machine half proven here; full canary half is T-08's. AC-81 in-process only (one phase field, projections agree); over-socket is T-04c's test-full. Seams for T-04b/T-04c documented in room/README.md: rooms::Sessions (close_snapshot once, release), AppState::set_live_counts, Room::accepts_answers, Room::revision, view::{wall,buzzer,host}. Code review PASS (sonnet), one Minor fixed in f7faccd. CI (just test, just test-full) was running at PR open.

ORCHESTRATOR: DONE verified (PR #15 @ f7faccd == remote, just test SUCCESS, review PASS on 16471a6 with the Minor fixed mechanically). Rulings on your deviations: (1) correct-index twin: keep the exact mirror of bank.py for now; PQ-20 is changing bank.correct_index under F-19 (panic/ub by option kind), and PQ-31 (minted, depends on PQ-4 and PQ-20) changes the Rust twin to match once both are on main. (2) noted on PQ-25: T-20's push arranges options into wall order. (7) noted on PQ-27 for T-22. The rest are accepted as recorded. Your tab closes now; thank you.
